metadata.question: On August 6, 2024 at 1:40 pm local time, were land surface temperatures along the Paris Olympic marathon starting line (Hôtel de Ville) lower than in the Fausses-Reposes forest near Versailles?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Primary: MODIS Aqua LST daily (MODIS/061/MYD11A1), which has ~13:30 local overpass near the target 13:40 local time on 2024-08-06. Filter date to 2024-08-06.
- Geometry: Two buffered points: Hôtel de Ville (Paris) and Fausses-Reposes forest near Versailles.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Use QC_Day bits (0–1 == 0 for best quality). If no valid pixels, relax to <=1.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collection size; if 0 -> C1.
- Check pixel counts after masking; if 0 even after relaxed QC -> C2.
- If means are null/NaN or outside plausible [-50, 70] C -> C3.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    // Hotel de Ville (approx): 48.8566, 2.3522
    const hvPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([2.3522, 48.8566]);
    const hvGeom = hvPoint.buffer(500); // 0.5 km buffer around start line area
    // Fausses-Reposes forest (approx center): 48.824, 2.178
    const frPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([2.178, 48.824]);
    const frGeom = frPoint.buffer(1000); // 1 km buffer

    const targetLocalHours = 13.6667; // 13:40 local
    const dateStart = '2024-08-06';
    const dateEnd = '2024-08-07';

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11A1')
      .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd);
    const size = await col.size().getInfo();
    if (size === 0) {
      // Try 1-day wider window
      col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11A1').filterDate('2024-08-05', '2024-08-07');
    }
    const size2 = await col.size().getInfo();
    if (size2 === 0) {
      console.log('MYD11A1 Images: 0');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    const img = ee.Image(col.first());

    // Build masks
    const qc = img.select('QC_Day');
    const goodStrict = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0);
    const goodRelax = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1);
    const lstK = img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02); // Kelvin
    const lstC_strict = lstK.updateMask(goodStrict).subtract(273.15).rename('LST_C');
    const lstC_relax = lstK.updateMask(goodRelax).subtract(273.15).rename('LST_C');
    const viewTime = img.select('Day_view_time');

    // Helper to get stats
    async function regionStats(geom, useRelax) {
      const lstBand = useRelax ? lstC_relax : lstC_strict;
      const countMasked = await lstBand.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('LST_C').getInfo();
      const totalCount = await img.select('LST_Day_1km').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo();
      const meanC = await lstBand.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('LST_C').getInfo();
      const meanTime = await viewTime.updateMask(lstBand.mask()).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('Day_view_time').getInfo();
      return { countMasked: countMasked || 0, totalCount: totalCount || 0, meanC, meanTime };
    }

    // First try strict QC
    let hv = await regionStats(hvGeom, false);
    let fr = await regionStats(frGeom, false);

    let qcRelaxedUsed = false;
    if (hv.countMasked === 0 || fr.countMasked === 0) {
      // Relax QC and recompute
      qcRelaxedUsed = true;
      hv = await regionStats(hvGeom, true);
      fr = await regionStats(frGeom, true);
    }

    // 3. Processing / Validation (C1/C2/C3)
    console.log(`MYD11A1 ${dateStart} imgs: ${size2}`);
    if (qcRelaxedUsed) console.log('QC relaxed (accepting good+other quality).');

    const hvCloudPct = (hv.totalCount > 0) ? (100 * (1 - hv.countMasked / hv.totalCount)) : null;
    const frCloudPct = (fr.totalCount > 0) ? (100 * (1 - fr.countMasked / fr.totalCount)) : null;

    console.log(`HV pixels: ${hv.countMasked}/${hv.totalCount} (cloud%≈${hvCloudPct !== null ? hvCloudPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'})`);
    console.log(`FR pixels: ${fr.countMasked}/${fr.totalCount} (cloud%≈${frCloudPct !== null ? frCloudPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'})`);

    if (hv.totalCount === 0 || fr.totalCount === 0) {
      console.log('C1'); // unexpectedly no pixels counted at all in region from the source band
      return;
    }
    if (hv.countMasked === 0 || fr.countMasked === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Means and times
    const hvMean = hv.meanC;
    const frMean = fr.meanC;
    const hvTime = hv.meanTime;
    const frTime = fr.meanTime;

    console.log(`ViewTime(h): HV=${hvTime !== null ? hvTime.toFixed(2) : 'NA'}, FR=${frTime !== null ? frTime.toFixed(2) : 'NA'}`);
    console.log(`LST_C(°C): HV=${hvMean !== null ? hvMean.toFixed(2) : 'NA'}, FR=${frMean !== null ? frMean.toFixed(2) : 'NA'}`);

    // 4. Calculation Validation (C3)
    function invalid(v) {
      return v === null || isNaN(v) || v < -50 || v > 70;
    }
    if (invalid(hvMean) || invalid(frMean)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Final Answer: Is HV < FR?
    const answer = hvMean < frMean ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
